meta.prompt: Draft an email to my landlord about the broken heating and show it as an inline card I can edit before it goes: to, subject and body fields filled in, a tone switch between polite and firm that rewrites the body, and send and discard buttons. Sending needs a recipient and a subject, and afterwards the card shows it as sent.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Email to landlord" "Draft, edit before sending" icon:"mail" status:=sent?"Sent":"Draft" tone:=sent?"good":"accent" w:390
  state sent=false
  state tone="Polite"
  state to="landlord@example.com"
  state subject="Heating not working in my flat"
  state body="Dear Landlord,

I hope you are well. The heating in my flat stopped working a few days ago, and the apartment is getting quite cold. Could you please arrange for someone to take a look at it when convenient?

I am happy to provide access at any time that suits. Thank you very much for your help.

Kind regards"
  if sent
    Receipt "Email sent" "Your message to {to} is on its way." tone:good icon:"check"
  if !sent
    SectionLabel "Tone"
    Segments =tone options:["Polite","Firm"] -> body=result=="Polite"?"Dear Landlord,

I hope you are well. The heating in my flat stopped working a few days ago, and the apartment is getting quite cold. Could you please arrange for someone to take a look at it when convenient?

I am happy to provide access at any time that suits. Thank you very much for your help.

Kind regards":"Dear Landlord,

The heating in my flat has been broken for several days. As the property is not currently habitable in this cold, I require a repair to be arranged within 48 hours.

Please confirm the date of the engineer's visit by reply. If I do not hear from you, I will have to consider my options under my tenancy agreement.

Regards"
    InputField "To" "name@example.com" =to keyboard:emailAddress error:=trim(to)==""?"Recipient required":""
    InputField "Subject" "Subject" =subject error:=trim(subject)==""?"Subject required":""
    InputField "Message" "Write your message" =body lines:9
    Row gap:10
      ActionButton "Discard" tone:quiet icon:"delete" -> to=""; subject=""; body=""; toast "Draft discarded"
      ActionButton "Send" tone:primary icon:"send" enabled:=trim(to)!=""&&trim(subject)!="" -> sent=true; emit send
